extDescription.message: Silently approves Muse approval requests through the signed-in page's RPC connection.

toggleHint.message: Approves silently via the page RPC. Only you can turn it off.

scopeNetworkHint.message: Only requests to access websites or domains

scopeAllHint.message: Includes connectors, devices, browser actions, outgoing media and checkout

scopeAllWarning.message: ⚠ This scope auto-approves checkout, outgoing content and device actions, and prefers long-term grants. Types other than network are untested.

statusNoneHint.message: Turn on the switch or check the connection below.

probingHint.message: Querying pending approvals in an open Muse tab.

probeNoWorker.message: Cannot reach the extension background. Reload the extension.

note1.message: Stay signed in to Muse and keep a conversation tab open. The Approvals panel does not need to be open.

note2.message: Uses the long-term grant offered by the server when available; otherwise allows once.

note3.message: Stops working when the page is closed, the computer sleeps, or the sign-in expires.

note4.message: Long-term grants must be revoked in Muse.

heartbeatStale.message: ⚠ No automatic check for over a minute (last at $1). Reload the Muse page.

connectedDetail.message: Silent RPC connected · $1 pending · $2 in scope

code_rpc_unavailable_or_ambiguous.message: No single connected Muse session found. Open a signed-in conversation.

code_rpc_failed.message: RPC call failed. This request will be retried in 60 seconds.

code_approval_not_confirmed.message: The server did not confirm the approval. Retrying in 60 seconds.

code_gateway_changed.message: The session connection changed. Retrying in 60 seconds.

code_authorization_expired.message: The page responded too slowly. Retrying in 60 seconds.

code_unsupported_decision.message: The request changed or expired. Checking again in 60 seconds.

code_interrupted.message: The page or extension connection was interrupted. Retrying shortly.

code_tab_reloading.message: Chrome unloaded the Muse tab to save memory. Reloading it.

code_busy.message: Another run is in progress. Try again shortly.

code_wrong_origin.message: The tab is not a Muse page.

code_no_result.message: The page returned no result. Reload the Muse page.

code_no_muse_tab.message: No Muse tab is open. Open a signed-in conversation.

localeCode.description: Internal: identifies which catalog Chrome selected. Must equal the directory name.

confirmBody.message: This extension is not affiliated with Muse. Once on, it approves requests on your behalf without asking, including long-term grants that stay in effect after you turn it off. It relies on Muse's private protocol, which can change or break at any time, and automating approvals may be against Muse's terms.

confirmAllScope.message: ⚠ The selected scope also approves checkout, outgoing content and device actions.
